snp4.16:1.1: NIṬṬHITAṂ. Sāriputtasutta. "Na me diṭṭho ito pubbe icc-āyasmā Sāriputto na-ssuto uda {kassaci} evaṃ vagguvado satthā Tusitā gaṇi-m-āgato || ||
snp4.16:2.1: sadevakassa lokassa, yathā dissati cakkhumā: sabbaṃ tamaṃ vinodetvā eko va ratim ajjhagā. || ||
snp4.16:3.1: Tam Buddhaṃ asitaṃ tādiṃ akuhaṅ gaṇim āgataṃ bahunnam idha baddhānaṃ atthi pañhena āgamiṃ: || ||
snp4.16:4.1: Bhikkhuno vijigucchato bhajato rittam āsanaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ susānaṃ vā, pabbatānaṃ guhāsu vā || ||
snp4.16:5.1: uccāvacesu sayanesu, kīvanto tattha bheravā, yehi bhikkhu na vedheyya nigghose sayanāsane. || ||
snp4.16:6.1: Kati parissayā loke gacchato amataṃ disaṃ, ye bhikkhu abhisambhave pantamhi sayanāsane. || ||
snp4.16:7.1: Ky-āssa vyappathayo assu, ky-āss' assu idha gocarā, kāni sīlabbatān' assu pahitattassa bhikkhuno. || ||
snp4.16:8.1: Kaṃ so sikkhaṃ samādāya ekodi nipako sato kammāro rajatasseva niddhame malam attano". || ||
snp4.16:9.1: "Vijigucchamānassa yad idaṃ phāsu, Sāriputtā ti Bhagavā rittāsanaṃ sayanaṃ sevato ce sambodhikāmassa, yathānudhammaṃ taṃ te pavakkhāmi yathā pajānaṃ. || ||
snp4.16:10.1: Pañcannaṃ dhīro bhayānaṃ na bhāye bhikkhu sato (sa) pariyantacārī: ḍaṃsādhipātānaṃ siriṃsapānaṃ manussaphassānaṃ catuppadānaṃ, || ||
snp4.16:11.1: paradhammikānam pi na santaseyya disvā pi tesaṃ bahubheravāni, athāparāni abhisambhaveyya parissayāni kusalānesī. || ||
snp4.16:12.1: Ātaṃkaphassena khudāya phuṭṭho sītaṃ accuṇhaṃ adhivāsayeyya, sa tehi phuṭṭho bahudhā anoko viriyaṃ parakkamma daḷhaṃ kareyya. || ||
snp4.16:13.1: Theyyaṃ na kareyya, na musā bhaṇeyya, mettāya phasse tasathāvarāni, yad āvilattaṃ manaso vijaññā, ‘kaṇhassa pakkho' ti vinodayeyya. || ||
snp4.16:14.1: Kodhātimānassa vasaṃ na gacche, mūlam pi tesaṃ palikhañña tiṭṭhe, atha-ppiyaṃ vā pana appiyaṃ vā addhā bhavanto abhisambhaveyya. || ||
snp4.16:15.1: Paññaṃ purakkhatvā kalyāṇapīti vikkhambhaye tāni parissayāni, aratiṃ sahetha sayanamhi pante, caturo sahetha paridevadhamme: || ||
snp4.16:16.1: ‘kiṃ su asissāmi, kuvaṃ vā asissaṃ dukkhaṃ vata settha, kuv' ajja sessaṃ' ete vitakke paridevaneyye vinayetha sekho aniketasārī. || ||
snp4.16:17.1: Annañ ca laddhā vasanañ ca kāle mattaṃ so jaññā idha tosanatthaṃ, sotesu gutto yatacāri gāme rusito pi vācaṃ pharusaṃ na vajjā. || ||
snp4.16:18.1: Okkhittacakkhu na ca pādalolo jhānānuyutto bahujāgar' assa, upekham ārabbha samāhitatto takkāsayaṃ kukkucciy' ūpacchinde. || ||
snp4.16:19.1: Cudito vacīhi satimābhinande, sabrahmacārīsu khilaṃ pabhinde, vācaṃ pamuñce kusalaṃ nātivelaṃ, janavādadhammāya na cetayeyya. || ||
snp4.16:20.1: Athāparaṃ pañca rajāni loke yesaṃ satīmā vinayāya sikkhe: rūpesu saddesu atho rasesu gandhesu phassesu sahetha rāgaṃ. || ||
snp4.16:21.1: Etesu dhammesu vineyya chandaṃ bhikkhu satīmā{} suvimuttacitto kālena so samma dhammaṃ parivīmaṃsamāno ekodibhūto vihane tamaṃ so" ti Bhagavā ti || || SĀRIPUTTASUTTAṂ NIṬṬHITAṂ. Aṭṭhakavaggo catuttho.
snp4.16:22.0: Tass' uddānaṃ: Kāma-Guhañ ca Duṭṭhā ca Suddhañ ca Paramā Jarā Metteyyo ca Pasūro ca Māgandi Purabhedanaṃ
snp4.16:23.1: Kalahaṃ dve ca Vyūhāni punar eva Tuvaṭṭakaṃ Attadaṇḍavarasuttaṃ Therapañhena soḷasa, tāni etāni suttāni sabbān' Aṭṭhakavaggikā ti.|
